# Summary

Run: **`r params$run`**

Number of samples run:  **`r params$n_samples`**

Input type: **`r switch(params$input_type, "fasta" = "Consensus sequences (FASTA)", "long-read" = "Long-read sequencing (FASTQ)", "Short-read sequencing (FASTQ)")`**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(gt)
library(htmltools)

is_fasta <- params$input_type == "fasta"
```


```{r}
# FASTQ input: per-gene coverage/depth from samtools coverage.
# FASTA input: per-gene "was a consensus record assessed?" from the differ.
coverage_df <- NULL
assessed_df <- NULL

if (!is_fasta) {
  coverage_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.coverage\\.tsv$")
  coverage_df <- coverage_files |>
      map_dfr(
          ~read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
              mutate(
                  Sample = tools::file_path_sans_ext(
                      tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))
                  )
              )
      )
} else {
  assessed_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.assessed\\.tsv$")
  assessed_df <- assessed_files |>
      map_dfr(~read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))
}
```


```{r}
if (!is_fasta) {
coverage_summary <- coverage_df |>
    group_by(Gene) |>
    summarise(
        Samples_total = n(),
        Samples_over95 = sum(COVERAGE >= 95),
        Percent_over95 = round(
            Samples_over95 / Samples_total * 100,
            1
        )
    )
}
#coverage_summary
```

```{r}
        x = Gene,
        y = Sample,
        fill = COVERAGE,
        text = paste0(
            "Sample: ", Sample,
            "<br>Gene: ", Gene,
            "<br>Coverage: ", round(COVERAGE,1), "%",

        )

) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
        name = "Coverage (%)",
        limits = c(0,100)
    ) +

        axis.text.y = element_text(size=8)
    )

ggplotly(coverage_heatmap, tooltip="text")
```

```{r}
# Per-sample x gene overview: which gene regions had a consensus record, and
# how well it aligned to the reference.
if (is_fasta) {
  if (is.null(assessed_df) || nrow(assessed_df) == 0) {
    cat("No consensus records were assessed in this run.")
  } else {
    assessed_wide <- assessed_df |>
      mutate(
        cell = paste0(
          round(as.numeric(pct_identity), 1), "% (", aligned_bp, " bp)",
          ifelse(tolower(reverse_complemented) %in% c("yes", "true"), " [rc]", "")
        )
      ) |>
      select(sample, gene, cell) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = gene, values_from = cell, values_fill = "not assessed") |>
      rename(Sample = sample)

    assessed_gt <- assessed_wide |> gt() |>
      tab_options(table.font.size = "90%")
  }
}
if (exists("assessed_gt")) assessed_gt
```

`r if (exists("is_fasta") && is_fasta) "Values show alignment identity and aligned length; [rc] marks records that were reverse-complemented to match the reference orientation. \"not assessed\" means no consensus record was supplied for that gene." else ""`

```{r}
resistance_files <- list.files(
    pattern="\\.resistance\\.tsv$"
)

resistance_df <- resistance_files |>
    purrr::map_dfr(
        ~read_tsv(
            .x,
            col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
        ) |>
        mutate(
            Sample = tools::file_path_sans_ext(
                tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))
            )
        )
    )


if(nrow(resistance_df)==0){
  cat("No characterised resistance mutations were detected.")
} else {
  # The phenotype database is already in long format (one row per
  # Gene_Mutation / Drug) with a pre-computed EC50_ratio (rounded to 2 dp by
  # db_matching.py) and Level_of_resistance, so no per-study averaging is done
  # here - we just tidy and collapse to one row per Gene/Mutation/Drug.
  levels <- c("Susceptible", "Low", "Medium", "High")

  format_level <- function(x){

    x <- factor(na.omit(x), levels = levels, ordered = TRUE)

    if(length(x) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    lo <- min(x)
    hi <- max(x)

    if(lo == hi)
      as.character(lo)
    else
      paste0(lo, "–", hi)
  }

  format_ec50 <- function(x){

    nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
    nums <- sort(nums[!is.na(nums)])

    if(length(nums) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    fmt <- function(v) format(round(v, 2), trim = TRUE, nsmall = 0)

    if(min(nums) == max(nums))
      fmt(min(nums))
    else
      sprintf("%s–%s", fmt(min(nums)), fmt(max(nums)))
  }

  format_refs <- function(x){

    keys <- unlist(strsplit(paste(stats::na.omit(x), collapse = ", "), ",\\s*"))
    keys <- unique(trimws(keys))
    keys <- keys[!is.na(keys) & keys != "" & keys != "NA"]

    if(length(keys) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    paste0("[@", keys, "]", collapse = "; ")
  }

  # Prefer exact single-mutation database entries; only fall back to compound
  # (combination-mutation) entries for a Gene/Mutation/Drug with no exact match.
  resis_use <- resistance_df |>
    group_by(Gene, Mutation, Drug) |>
    filter(if(any(match_type == "exact")) match_type == "exact" else TRUE) |>
    ungroup()

  summary_df <- resis_use |>
    group_by(Gene, Mutation, Drug) |>
    summarise(
      `EC50 ratio` = format_ec50(EC50_ratio),
      `Level of resistance` = format_level(Level_of_resistance),
      Reference = format_refs(References),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  level_order <- c(
    "Unknown",
    "Susceptible",
    "Low",
    "Medium",
    "High"
  )

  highest_level <- function(x) {

    if (is.na(x) || x == "")
      return("Unknown")

    # Split ranges like "Low–Medium"
    levs <- unlist(strsplit(x, "–"))

    levs <- factor(levs,
                  levels = level_order,
                  ordered = TRUE)

    as.character(max(levs))
  }

  summary_table <- summary_df

  summary_table$Drug <- factor(
    summary_table$Drug,
    levels = c(
      "Ganciclovir",
      "Foscarnet",
      "Cidofovir",
      "Maribavir",
      "Letermovir"
    )
  )

  summary_table <-
    summary_table |>
    mutate(Resistance = vapply(`Level of resistance`, highest_level, character(1))) |>
    select(Gene, Mutation, Drug, Resistance) |>
    distinct() |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Drug,
      values_from = Resistance,
      names_expand = TRUE,
      values_fill = "Unknown"
    ) |>
    select(
      Gene,
      Mutation,
      Ganciclovir,
      Foscarnet,
      Cidofovir,
      Maribavir,
      Letermovir
    )

  legend <- HTML(
    paste(
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#A9A9A9;border:1px solid black;'></span> Unknown (not found in database)",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#00FF00;border:1px solid black;'></span> Susceptible (< 2 EC50 ratio)",
      "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#FFFF00;border:1px solid black;'></span> Low (>= 2 & < 5 EC50 ratio)",
      "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#FFA500;border:1px solid black;'></span> Medium (>= 5 & < 15 EC50 ratio)",
      "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#FF0000;border:1px solid black;'></span> High (>= 15 EC50 ratio)"
      )
    )

  tbl <- gt(summary_table)
  tbl <- tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Letermovir,
        rows = Letermovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Letermovir,
        rows = Letermovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(

      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(

      )
    ) |>

      )
    ) |> tab_source_note(source_note = legend)


  tbl
}
```
